content: “Ma wọ ode aphaangi p'ánang anọng p'Israẹl.
Asana p'akhuri abira p'aHiburu
“Idikha adebhi obira kw'ode oHiburu-nọng, kẹ ósi ọtzọhm k'irekh-irek kwọ ka cho azadani. Yina, ottong cho azenamfa, kẹ ọ́naanga ebira, ọttọhk kpenamkpen kọ́nang.
Idikha okwu mancheni, ọ́kpa nnam mancheni. Yina, otzim kwanọng kwẹ okwu, kẹ obiro ọ́kpa nnam ttara kwanọng kwẹ.
Idikha itta kwẹ ọnang-ẹ obira wani kwẹ kw'ikwanọng bi, ọtzọkha, ọmmaan-ẹ va p'ijinọng, ttara p'ipanọng, kwanọng nwuma ttara va pẹ án-ade p'itta kwẹ, ojinọng kẹ-khẹ wọ ófona ọbhana.
“Yina, idikha obira nwuma osi ẹjaakhi bi, ‘Kaam itta kwaam, ọmaana kwanọng kwaam, ttara va paam adaakh-m ọdaak, kokher bi ọnaanga ebira,’
itta kwẹ ọkhaambi otzim-ẹ ọtza ọkhọkha akpaar-aponga. Kẹ ótzim-ẹ ochina k'ẹkpọmmachi ch'ẹhọmma, ọ́ju-ẹ itzọhng ttara ejum. Mẹ wọ, ón-ode kwẹ k'akpen pẹ biphyir.
“Idikha ọnọng ọtzọk nnwa kwẹ kw'ikwanọng okpe k'ebira, ominanwa nwa mach'obira kw'ijinọng om-ofona k'idukhi, kófona.

Idikha ominanwa nwa oni itta kwẹ idik ọdaakhi, tte kẹ ọttẹ-ẹ ọbọhk, bẹ abhekh-ẹ k'ebira. Itta kwẹ ẹfa kọkhaam bi, ọkpẹ-ẹ ọnang okhekhennọng, okhuri bi, itta nwa kwẹ, echekhi ch'ọnangi obira nwa kohokhi.
Idikha ọtzọhk ominanwa nwa ọnang nnwa kwẹ kw'ijinọng, kẹ ósi macha bẹ am-asi anang va p'ipanọng.
Mẹ wọ, obiro ọtzọkha kwanọng ọdọdọk, kẹ kọ̀khaambi ọrọbha ocheden kwanọng chen, ọnang-ẹ ọchattọhk, ọnang-ẹ ọbara fa for, ttara eyima.
Idikha kẹ oni kwanọng nwa ekpo mbya ẹttaan ọnangi, kwanọng nwa ọbaan bi, ọbhana k'idukhi, ogbukha manda wani kọ̀nang k'ẹnaanga chẹ.
Aphaangi p'akhuri ekpo-omumumma
“Ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'obuni oyok ọttọhk, ọfhẹ-ẹ, kẹ bẹ abira áfhẹ-ẹ ofhu.
Yina, idikha oni k'ọgbaan otzim ọfhẹ-ẹ, da kwẹ ode bi, Ibinọkpaabyi wọ otte kwẹ ọbọhk otto, tte kẹ ọrọbh otza ochubha k'ibe sa kaam ńdekha.
Yina, ọnọng on-obiro ọkham oyok, ọfhẹ-ẹ k'ọgbaan, bọng dim-ẹ abina aji ijafọhnibe saam, atza afhẹ-ẹ.
“Ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'ofhu otte, oyongi mẹ, obiro ofhu ọkka, bẹ akhaambi afhẹ-ẹ.
“Ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'ofu ọnọngẹya, ode bi okpẹ-ẹ okpe, obiro ode bi, bẹ akhebh-ẹ ttara ọnọng nwuma ka mbọhk, bẹ akhaambi afhẹ-ẹ.
“Ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'ọnangi otte ẹmma, obira ode bi ọnangi ọkka ẹmma, bẹ akhaambi afhẹ-ẹ.
“Idikha anọng afa asi ẹkhọhr, oyok wani ọtzọbh oyok ọtza, oyongi mẹ obun-ẹ ẹbọhkduk, maa oyok oyima ọkhọhmmana,

kẹ kw'obuni oyok ẹbọhkduk ọmmamma kọ̀tzọkha, idikha oyok ọnang ẹbọhkduk nduma, obina orenga ttara ochikhura kwẹ, kẹ ọ́mọnga agbukha ọnang oyok, k'ogbe kw'okk'oyok okhibhi, obiro ókker-ẹ maa, for igaang-ẹ.
“Idikha ọnọng ottumi obira kwẹ kw'ijinọng, obir ode kw'ikwanọng ttara ochinnwa, maa ope ka mbọhk sẹ, bẹ akhaambi bẹ anang ọnọng-dema nwuma ọmmamma.
Yina, idikha obira nwuma ọnang ngwur nnuma, ode ewu dani o, obiro ode iwu ifa o, ọkhaam-obira nwa ọmmamma kọ̀tzọkha, da obira nwa ode agbukha pẹ.

“Idikha ajinọng afa arim-erima, bẹ atza abun kwanọng kw'otzim ibhọr ọttọhk, ofona mẹ, ibhọr nna iyin, da ogbe kwẹ on-otzim obenga, yina, ọttọhk f'ọbar-ọbar komum, otzukha kpenamkpen kw'odim kwa kwanọng nwa ọkpaar, esobh ebire ekhera, mando kw'ótzuk.
Yina, idikha kwanọng nwa omum ekpo k'idendama, tzima akpen atzera akpen,
ọju-ẹ chen, bẹ aju-ẹ chen, ọkpaar-ẹ ọbọhk, bẹ akpaar-ẹ ọbọhk, ọrọbh-ẹ ẹha, bẹ arọbh-ẹ ẹha, ọkpaar-ẹ obho, bẹ akpaar-ẹ obho,
ọkwọm-ẹ ekpon, bẹ akwọm-ẹ ekpon, omum-ẹ ọttọhk, bẹ amum-ẹ ọttọhk, owong-ẹ owonga, bẹ atzukha ttara ewonga.
“Idikha ọnọng ottumi obira kwẹ kw'ijinọng, kaambi obiro ode kw'ikwanọng ka chen, ọju-ẹ chen, kẹ ọkhaambi otte obira nwa ọbọhk ofona k'idukhi, okhuri chen ch'oju-ẹ.
Idikha ọnọng ottumi obira kwẹ, kw'ijinọng, kaambi obiro ode kw'ikwanọng, ọrọbh-ẹ ẹha, kẹ ọkhaambi otte obira nwa ọbọhk ofona k'idukhi, okhuri ẹha chẹ ch'ọkk'ọrọbha.

“Idikha ọbhaamdim okhumi ọnọng abhik, ode ojinọng, obiro ode kwanọng maa ope, bẹ akhaambi atzọbh ọbhaamdim-dema nwa atza maa ope, etzen chẹ k'ẹchaa kẹ̀baan. Kaambi mẹ wọ, ọkhaam-ọbhaamdim nwa, odik koji.

Yina, idikha ọbhaamdim nwa okk'anọng abhik om-okhuma, bẹ atzọr ọkhaam itzọhng, yina, chẹ kọ̀bọhk okhe k'ikwuri, maa chẹ efhu ọnọng, bẹ atzọbh ọbhaamdim nwa atza maa ope, bẹ abira afhu ọkhaam-ẹbhaamdim.
Mẹ wọ, idikha bẹ akpaar otzukha anang-ẹ, kẹ ọkhaambi da otzuk kpenamkpen fa bẹ akpaar anang-ẹ, ifha otzima obhek akpen pẹ.
Ọphaangi nwa obiro obe ọnang bi, idikha ọbhaamdim okhumi nnwa kw'ijinọng, obiro ode nnwa kw'ikwanọng obhik, ọfhẹ-ẹ.

Idikha ọbhaamdim okhumi obira kw'ijinọng, obiro ode obira kw'ikwanọng obhik, ọkhaam-ọbhaamdim ọkhaambi ọnang ọkhaam-obira, ashẹkẹl ẹrọbh obhiri jobh p'asilva, bẹ akhaambi abira atzọbh ọbhaamdim nwa atza maa ope.
“Idikha ọnọng otzumi ipekhuma otte eje, ode ẹbhaam, ode bi ẹnyanyaang dọ, etto k'ẹtzaanga,
ọnọng kw'otzumi ipekhuma nna, ọkhaambi ọtzuk ọnang ọkhaam-ẹbhaam, kẹ ọ́tzọkha otzen-bukhi.
“Idikha ọbhaamdim kw'ọnọng omum ọbhaamdim kw'oyok ọttọhk ọfhẹ-ẹ, bẹ akhaambi akpe ọbhaamdim kw'owobh akpen, akkema agbukha, bẹ abira akkema otzenbukhi ebengambọhk.
Yina, idikha anọng arong bi, ọbhaamdim nnwa okk'anọng abhik om-okhuma, yina, ọkhaam-ẹbhaam chẹ kọ̀bọk okhe k'ikwuri, ọkhaam-ẹbhaam ótzima ẹbhaam otzuk ẹbhaam, ọbhaam-bukhi ón-ode kwẹ.
